uncertain_pairs.why: Merged, but 273 never names its source; if Pimblett's 'wants Topuria or Tsarukyan' came from a different appearance than the Green Light podcast they should split.
Same speaker, same message, days apart, but 361 credits the Helwani podcast and quotes different lines; could be one interview reported loosely.
402's headline (return end of year or early 2027) is the Gallo news in 412, but its visible body is the Merab/Helen Yee update; may belong with 412 or be a two-story article.
305 leads with the trainer's 'physically ready by year end, early next year is safer' line that is exactly 412's news, six days earlier.
Tweet clips were posted within seconds of each other and both are English Topuria quotes; likely the same Rogan podcast, which would make them one story.
The divorce quote was clipped the same day as the Rogan clips and is in English; it may be from the same Rogan appearance.
Both are personal-life confessions in Spanish outlets with no source named; could be two cuts of the same long interview.
